issues.detail: prompt_to_repeat contains '<<이름>>', so any answer that repeats the prompt passes detectable_format:title even without a titled company name. Same in English ('<<name>>').
'feed' rendered as forbidden '수유' (breast/bottle feeding), narrower than English 'feed'; an answer writing '밥을 먹이다' passes. Defensible for infant context; scope narrowed, not broken.
Forbidden stems '모저' and '바리' occur inside common words (이모저모, 바리스타, 발바리), so honest answers can fail; '유리공장' misses spaced '유리 공장'. Violates guideline rule 3 on non-hiding stems.
Prompt asks for three keywords (지표, 목표, 관리) but kwargs check only 지표 and 관리, so an answer omitting 목표 passes. English has the same mismatch ('objective' absent from kwargs).
'반드시 부스터 단어로 시작' has no quotes or '라는', so it can read as 'a booster word'. Suggest "'부스터'라는 단어로" to name first_word unambiguously.
Prompt requires a <<title>> on both cover letters; detectable_format:title passes on any single non-empty <<…>> span, so one untitled letter still passes. Same in English.
